entities.summary: Shō Iku was a monarchs & rulers in Shuri Castle (1813-08-19, Shuri Castle – 1847-10-25) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and empire and colonial dynamics. Established dynastic legacies and territorial boundaries.
